chart.title: Share of senior and middle management positions filled by women
chart.subtitle: Women who are employed in decision-making and management roles in government, as well as large enterprises and institutions.
chart.note: Differences in the levels of responsibility between men and women, and the enterprises and institutions for which they work, are not considered.

5.5.2 - Proportion of women in senior an.descriptionKey: Employment in senior and middle management is defined based on the [International Standard Classification of Occupations](https://ilostat.ilo.org/methods/concepts-and-definitions/classification-occupation/). This series refers to major group 1 of ISCO-08 or ISCO-88, excluding sub-major groups 14 in ISCO-08 and 13 in ISCO-88.
